General Information

What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM Windshield Glass Rubber Seal
It is used whenever you replace your front windshield glass or need to replace the original rubber seal due to drying out and cracking
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement

What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
